## Scope

Descriptive analysis of dichotomized participation items.

## Analyses Navigation

This report is part of the analyses folder, where the project will centralize visualizations, statistical analyses, and models.

- Analyses index: [analyses/README.md](README.md)
- This report (HTML): [analyses/items_descriptions.html](items_descriptions.html)
- GitHub Pages link pattern: `https://<your-user>.github.io/<your-repo>/analyses/items_descriptions.html`

When GitHub Pages is enabled for the repository, replace `<your-user>` and `<your-repo>` in the URL above.

Coding used in this report:

- Values 1 and 2 are recoded to 0.
- Values 3 and 4 are recoded to 1.
- Missing values are never displayed in plots.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(purrr)

set.seed(20260803)

resolve_pooled_path <- function() {
  candidates <- c(
    "proc/output/pooled_data.rds",
    "output/pooled_data.rds",
    "../proc/output/pooled_data.rds",
    "../../proc/output/pooled_data.rds"
  )

  hits <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    stop("pooled_data.rds not found.")
  }

  normalizePath(hits[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

required_cols <- c(
  "study", "label_country", "contact", "peaceful", "sign", "spray", "trafic", "occupy",
  "gender", "parents_hisced", "civic_test", "gini"
)

db <- readRDS(resolve_pooled_path())
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(db))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

years <- c(1999, 2009, 2016, 2022)
item_vars <- c("contact", "peaceful", "sign", "spray", "trafic", "occupy")

item_meta <- tibble(
  item = item_vars,
  item_label = c(
    "Contact representative", "Peaceful protest", "Sign petition",
    "Spray slogans", "Block traffic", "Occupy buildings"
  ),
  item_type = c("Conventional", "Conventional", "Conventional", "Radical", "Radical", "Radical"),
  item_order = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6),
  item_color = c("#2C7FB8", "#4C9ED9", "#7FB9E8", "#C73E1D", "#DF6A4A", "#F29D84")
)

type_colors <- c("Conventional" = "#2C7FB8", "Radical" = "#C73E1D")
item_colors <- setNames(item_meta$item_color, item_meta$item_label)
gender_colors <- c("Men" = "#34495E", "Women" = "#E67E9A")
hisced_colors <- c("Non-university" = "#6B7280", "University" = "#0F766E")
region_colors <- c(
  "South America" = "#1F78B4",
  "North America" = "#33A02C",
  "Europe" = "#6A3D9A",
  "Asia" = "#E31A1C",
  "Africa" = "#FF7F00",
  "Oceania" = "#B15928",
  "Unknown" = "#9CA3AF"
)

normalize_country_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- iconv(x, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", " ", x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  recode(
    x,
    "russian federation" = "russia",
    "slovak republic" = "slovakia",
    "chinese taipei" = "taiwan",
    "korea republic of" = "korea",
    "hong kong sar" = "hong kong",
    "belgium flemish" = "belgium",
    "england" = "united kingdom",
    .default = x
  )
}

region_lookup <- tibble(
  country_key = c(
    "argentina", "australia", "austria", "belgium", "brazil", "bulgaria", "chile", "colombia",
    "croatia", "cyprus", "czech republic", "denmark", "dominican republic", "estonia", "finland",
    "france", "germany", "greece", "guatemala", "hong kong", "hungary", "indonesia", "ireland",
    "italy", "korea", "latvia", "liechtenstein", "lithuania", "luxembourg", "malta", "mexico",
    "netherlands", "new zealand", "norway", "paraguay", "peru", "poland", "portugal", "romania",
    "russia", "serbia", "slovakia", "slovenia", "spain", "sweden", "switzerland", "taiwan",
    "thailand", "united kingdom", "united states"
  ),
  region = c(
    "South America", "Oceania", "Europe", "Europe", "South America", "Europe", "South America", "South America",
    "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "North America", "Europe", "Europe",
    "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "North America", "Asia", "Europe", "Asia", "Europe",
    "Europe", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "North America",
    "Europe", "Oceania", "Europe", "South America", "South America", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe",
    "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Asia",
    "Asia", "Europe", "North America"
  )
)

theme_conference <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#e5e7eb"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f3f4f6"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

dichotomize_item <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0,
    x %in% c(3, 4) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

ci_prop <- function(p, n) {
  se <- sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / pmax(n, 1))
  low <- pmax(0, p - 1.96 * se)
  high <- pmin(1, p + 1.96 * se)
  list(low = low, high = high)
}

cor_ci <- function(r, n) {
  if (is.na(r) || is.na(n) || n <= 3 || abs(r) >= 1) {
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  }
  z <- atanh(r)
  se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
  z_low <- z - 1.96 * se
  z_high <- z + 1.96 * se
  c(tanh(z_low), tanh(z_high))
}

iso3_from_country <- function(x) {
  if (requireNamespace("countrycode", quietly = TRUE)) {
    out <- countrycode::countrycode(x, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c", warn = FALSE)
  } else {
    out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  }

  out[is.na(out)] <- toupper(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", x[is.na(out)]), 1, 3))
  out
}

pick_labels <- function(df, value_col = "pct", n_mid = 14) {
  value_sym <- rlang::sym(value_col)

  df |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
      n_rows <- nrow(.x)
      if (n_rows == 0) {
        return(.x)
      }

      ord <- .x |> arrange(!!value_sym)
      idx_bottom <- seq_len(min(3, n_rows))
      idx_top <- seq(max(1, n_rows - 2), n_rows)

      middle_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n_rows), union(idx_bottom, idx_top))
      n_mid_use <- min(n_mid, length(middle_idx))
      idx_mid <- if (n_mid_use > 0) sample(middle_idx, n_mid_use) else integer(0)

      keep_idx <- sort(unique(c(idx_bottom, idx_top, idx_mid)))
      keep_countries <- ord$label_country[keep_idx]
      keep_countries <- unique(c(keep_countries, "Chile"))

      .x |>
        mutate(label_flag = label_country %in% keep_countries)
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}

item_ordered_levels <- item_meta |>
  arrange(item_order) |>
  pull(item_label)

db_clean <- db |>
  mutate(
    study = as.integer(study),
    country_key = normalize_country_name(label_country),
    gender = case_when(
      gender == 0 ~ "Men",
      gender == 1 ~ "Women",
      gender == 2 ~ "Women",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    hisced_group = case_when(
      is.na(parents_hisced) ~ NA_character_,
      parents_hisced >= 4 ~ "University",
      parents_hisced < 4 ~ "Non-university",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(region_lookup, by = "country_key") |>
  mutate(region = coalesce(region, "Unknown")) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(item_vars), dichotomize_item, .names = "{.col}_bin"))

item_long <- db_clean |>
  select(
    study, label_country, country_key, region, gender, hisced_group, civic_test, gini,
    ends_with("_bin")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_bin"),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(item = str_remove(item, "_bin$")) |>
  left_join(item_meta, by = "item") |>
  mutate(item_label = factor(item_label, levels = item_ordered_levels))

country_item_year <- item_long |>
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(label_country), label_country != "") |>
  group_by(study, label_country, region, item, item_label, item_type) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct = mean(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ci = map2(pct, n, ci_prop),
    ci_low = map_dbl(ci, "low"),
    ci_high = map_dbl(ci, "high"),
    iso3 = iso3_from_country(label_country)
  ) |>
  select(-ci)

region_item_year <- country_item_year |>
  group_by(study, region, item, item_label) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ci = map2(pct, n, ci_prop),
    ci_low = map_dbl(ci, "low"),
    ci_high = map_dbl(ci, "high")
  ) |>
  select(-ci)

country_gini <- db_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(gini), !is.na(label_country), label_country != "") |>
  group_by(study, label_country, region) |>
  summarise(
    gini = mean(gini, na.rm = TRUE),
    iso3 = first(iso3_from_country(label_country)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_student_overall <- function(year_value) {
  d <- item_long |>
    filter(study == year_value, !is.na(value)) |>
    group_by(item_label, item_type) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      pct = mean(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ci = map2(pct, n, ci_prop),
      ci_low = map_dbl(ci, "low"),
      ci_high = map_dbl(ci, "high")
    ) |>
    select(-ci)

  type_means <- d |>
    group_by(item_type) |>
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = pct, y = fct_reorder(item_label, pct), fill = item_type)) +
    geom_vline(
      data = type_means,
      aes(xintercept = mean_pct, color = item_type),
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), height = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = type_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Percentage with value = 1", y = NULL) +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_student_by_gender <- function(year_value) {
  d <- item_long |>
    filter(study == year_value, !is.na(value), !is.na(gender)) |>
    group_by(item_label, gender) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      pct = mean(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ci = map2(pct, n, ci_prop),
      ci_low = map_dbl(ci, "low"),
      ci_high = map_dbl(ci, "high")
    ) |>
    mutate(gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Men", "Women"))) |>
    select(-ci)

  facet_mean <- d |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = gender, y = pct, fill = gender)) +
    geom_hline(data = facet_mean, aes(yintercept = mean_pct), linetype = 2, color = "#6b7280") +
    geom_col(width = 0.64) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.45, size = 3.3) +
    facet_wrap(~item_label, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gender_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage with value = 1") +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_student_civic_corr <- function() {
  d <- item_long |>
    filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(civic_test)) |>
    group_by(study, item_label, item_type) |>
    summarise(
      r = cor(civic_test, value, use = "complete.obs"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(study = factor(study, levels = years))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = study, y = item_label, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = number(r, accuracy = 0.01)), size = 3.4, color = "#111827") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "#F7F7F7",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    facet_grid(item_type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = NULL, fill = "r") +
    theme_conference() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)
    )
}

plot_pooled_trend_items <- function() {
  d <- item_long |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    group_by(study, item_label) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      pct = mean(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ci = map2(pct, n, ci_prop),
      ci_low = map_dbl(ci, "low"),
      ci_high = map_dbl(ci, "high")
    ) |>
    select(-ci)

  global_mean <- mean(d$pct, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = study, y = pct, color = item_label, group = item_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = global_mean, linetype = 2, color = "#6b7280") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0.16, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.7, size = 3.0, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = item_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Percentage with value = 1") +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_pooled_trend_corr <- function() {
  d <- item_long |>
    filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(civic_test)) |>
    group_by(study, item_label) |>
    summarise(
      r = cor(civic_test, value, use = "complete.obs"),
      n = sum(complete.cases(civic_test, value)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      ci_low = cor_ci(r, n)[1],
      ci_high = cor_ci(r, n)[2]
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  facet_mean <- d |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    summarise(mean_r = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = study, y = r, group = 1)) +
    geom_hline(data = facet_mean, aes(yintercept = mean_r), linetype = 2, color = "#9ca3af", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), fill = "#D1D5DB", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(color = "#1f2937", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_point(color = "#111827", size = 2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = number(r, accuracy = 0.01)), vjust = -0.7, size = 2.8) +
    facet_wrap(~item_label, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Correlation with civic_test") +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_country_bars_year <- function(year_value) {
  d <- country_item_year |>
    filter(study == year_value) |>
    pick_labels("pct") |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    mutate(country_order = rank(pct, ties.method = "first")) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(country_facet = paste0(item_label, "__", label_country))

  mean_ref <- d |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  d <- d |>
    group_by(item_label) |>
    arrange(pct, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(country_facet = factor(country_facet, levels = unique(country_facet))) |>
    ungroup()

  ggplot(d, aes(x = pct, y = country_facet, fill = region)) +
    geom_vline(data = mean_ref, aes(xintercept = mean_pct), linetype = 2, color = "#6b7280", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), height = 0.14, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(
      data = d |> filter(label_flag),
      aes(label = if_else(is.na(iso3), label_country, iso3)),
      hjust = -0.1,
      size = 2.4
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~item_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_replace(x, "^.*__", "")) +
    labs(x = "Country percentage with value = 1", y = NULL) +
    theme_conference() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
}

plot_country_change_time <- function() {
  d <- country_item_year

  facet_mean <- d |>
    group_by(region, item_label) |>
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  region_trend <- region_item_year

  ggplot(d, aes(x = study, y = pct, group = label_country, color = label_country)) +
    geom_hline(data = facet_mean, aes(yintercept = mean_pct), linetype = 2, color = "#9ca3af", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = region_trend,
      aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high, group = 1),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "#D1D5DB",
      alpha = 0.28
    ) +
    geom_line(data = region_trend, aes(y = pct, group = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "#111827", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(region ~ item_label) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Country percentage with value = 1") +
    theme_conference() +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
}

plot_country_gini_bars_year <- function(year_value) {
  d <- country_gini |>
    filter(study == year_value) |>
    group_by(study) |>
    mutate(
      label_flag = row_number() %in% c(1:8, pmax(n() - 7, 1):n()) | label_country == "Chile"
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No gini data for this year", size = 5) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  mean_ref <- mean(d$gini, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = gini, y = fct_reorder(label_country, gini), fill = region)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_ref, linetype = 2, color = "#6b7280") +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      data = d |> filter(label_flag),
      aes(label = if_else(is.na(iso3), label_country, iso3)),
      hjust = -0.1,
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
    labs(x = "Gini", y = NULL) +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_country_gini_change_time <- function() {
  d <- country_gini

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No gini data available", size = 5) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  facet_mean <- d |>
    group_by(region) |>
    summarise(mean_gini = mean(gini, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  region_trend <- d |>
    group_by(study, region) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      gini = mean(gini, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_gini = sd(gini, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      se = if_else(is.na(sd_gini), 0, sd_gini / sqrt(pmax(n, 1))),
      ci_low = gini - 1.96 * se,
      ci_high = gini + 1.96 * se
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(x = study, y = gini, group = label_country, color = label_country)) +
    geom_hline(data = facet_mean, aes(yintercept = mean_gini), linetype = 2, color = "#9ca3af", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = region_trend,
      aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high, group = 1),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "#D1D5DB",
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_line(data = region_trend, aes(y = gini, group = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "#111827", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~region, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Gini") +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_gini_effect_year <- function(year_value) {
  d <- country_item_year |>
    filter(study == year_value) |>
    left_join(country_gini |> select(study, label_country, gini), by = c("study", "label_country")) |>
    filter(!is.na(gini), !is.na(pct))

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No gini data for this year", size = 5) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  type_means <- d |>
    group_by(item_type) |>
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(d, aes(x = gini, y = pct, color = item_label)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = type_means,
      aes(yintercept = mean_pct, color = item_type),
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(item_colors, type_colors)) +
    labs(x = "Gini", y = "Country percentage with value = 1") +
    theme_conference()
}

plot_gini_item_country_lines <- function(year_value, item_label_value) {
  d <- country_item_year |>
    filter(study == year_value, item_label == item_label_value) |>
    left_join(country_gini |> select(study, label_country, gini, iso3), by = c("study", "label_country")) |>
    filter(!is.na(gini), !is.na(pct)) |>
    mutate(iso3 = coalesce(iso3.y, iso3.x, iso3_from_country(label_country)))

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No gini data for this year", size = 5) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  x_min <- min(d$gini, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_pad <- max(0.5, (max(d$gini, na.rm = TRUE) - x_min) * 0.04)

  d <- d |>
    mutate(x_start = x_min - x_pad)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = gini, y = pct)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = x_start, xend = gini, y = pct, yend = pct),
      color = "#111111",
      alpha = 0.55,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_point(color = "#111111", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = iso3),
      color = "#111111",
      size = 2.4,
      max.overlaps = 200,
      min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.03))) +
    labs(x = "Gini", y = "Country percentage with value = 1") +
    theme_conference()
}
```

## Validation checks

```{r}
check_binary <- db_clean |>
  summarise(across(ends_with("_bin"), ~ all(.x %in% c(0, 1, NA), na.rm = TRUE)))

check_missing_plot_inputs <- item_long |>
  summarise(
    pct_missing_value = mean(is.na(value)),
    pct_missing_gender = mean(is.na(gender)),
    pct_missing_hisced = mean(is.na(hisced_group)),
    pct_missing_civic = mean(is.na(civic_test)),
    pct_missing_gini = mean(is.na(gini))
  )

knitr::kable(check_binary, caption = "Binary coding check")
knitr::kable(check_missing_plot_inputs, digits = 3, caption = "Missingness in plot inputs")
```
